clue.text: Wreck party after upsetting Greek character

indicators.note: in a down clue, upsetting turns the Greek letter's name upside down, so it reads backwards

parts.note: nu is the thirteenth letter of the Greek alphabet
a do is a party or celebration

explanation.surface: A rowdy party ruins things after a Greek guest is knocked over.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'upsetting' flips the letter's name so it reads upwards, and 'after' places the party last.
explanation.definitionFit: To undo something is to ruin or destroy it, a synonym of wreck as a verb.

clue.text: Drop everything if this act goes wrong?

definitions.text: Drop everything if this act goes wrong?

parts.words: Drop everything if this act goes wrong?
parts.note: a performer keeping balls in the air drops them all when the act fails, so the clue describes that skill

explanation.surface: A warning that one mistake in a risky routine would bring everything crashing down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drop everything' usually means stop what you are doing; here it is literal, the balls hitting the floor.
explanation.definitionFit: Jugglery is the art of keeping objects tossed aloft, and a failed attempt means dropping them all.

clue.text: Lots of food generally eaten by saints

indicators.note: the food is swallowed inside the saints, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for saint, doubled for saints
tack is an informal word for food in general, as in hardtack

explanation.surface: Plenty of food being devoured by holy people.
explanation.definitionFit: Stacks is an informal plural meaning a large quantity, just as lots does.

clue.text: Eccentric folk handle component of engine

parts.note: cranks are odd or eccentric people
a haft is the handle of a knife or axe

explanation.surface: Odd people hold a handle that forms part of a motor.
explanation.definitionFit: A crankshaft is the rotating shaft in an engine that turns piston motion into rotation.

clue.text: Verbal communication — losing time, I had to be sluggish

indicators.note: losing tells us a piece is dropped from the word for verbal communication

parts.note: language is spoken or written communication
an age is a period of time
I'd is the contraction of I had

explanation.surface: Someone who has stopped talking for a while feels lethargic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'losing time' removes AGE from LANGUAGE, leaving LANGU.
explanation.definitionFit: Languid describes someone lacking energy or listless, a close synonym of sluggish.

clue.text: Latin name of German game

parts.note: Otto is a common German man's name

explanation.surface: Asking for the Latin origin of a German pastime's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Lotto is a game of chance played by matching numbers on cards, much like bingo.

clue.text: Suffering sort, I'd got lame — medical specialist required

indicators.note: suffering suggests something in a bad way, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A patient who has gone lame needs to see the right doctor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Suffering' shuffles SORT, ID, GOT and LAME into the thirteen letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A dermatologist is a doctor who specialises in skin conditions.

clue.text: Number hiding initially in part of the forest?

indicators.note: in places the first letter inside the word for part of a forest

parts.note: a tree is one part of a forest

indicators.note: initially points to the first letter of the word hiding

explanation.surface: A figure lurking among the woodland trees.
explanation.definitionFit: Three is a number, the integer after two.

clue.text: Global vision facilitator

parts.note: global here means shaped like a globe, and the round organ is what lets us see

explanation.surface: Sounds like a body promoting worldwide outlook or international insight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Global' looks like worldwide; it means spherical.
explanation.definitionFit: The round organ of sight in the socket is what makes vision possible.

clue.text: Powerful tenor pouring out heart completely in hymn?

indicators.note: completely in places the two letters wholly inside the word for a hymn

parts.note: a hymn is a song of praise
T is the abbreviation for tenor in music

indicators.note: the heart is the centre letter of pouring, taken out

explanation.surface: A tenor singing a hymn with his whole heart is powerful.
explanation.walkthrough: The heart of POURING is its fourth letter R; T and R go inside SONG.
explanation.definitionFit: Strong and powerful are synonyms describing great force or might.

clue.text: Worker taken in by bizarre creed forswore beliefs

indicators.note: the worker is absorbed inside the rearranged creed
bizarre means strange, so the letters of creed are put in odd order

parts.note: an ant is the classic crossword worker insect

explanation.surface: A labourer drawn into a strange cult renounces his faith.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bizarre' scrambles the creed's letters into RECED, and 'taken in by' signals that the insect sits inside them.
explanation.definitionFit: To recant is to withdraw a statement or abandon a belief, so recanted means forswore beliefs.

clue.text: Instrument finds a sort of fault with fish

parts.note: in tennis a double fault is two failed serves in a row
bass is a kind of fish

explanation.surface: A musical instrument found defective, with something fishy about it.
explanation.walkthrough: In tennis, a double fault is when a player misses both serves.
explanation.definitionFit: A double bass is the largest and lowest-pitched bowed string instrument of the orchestra.

clue.text: Starts to ask for opportunity to score

parts.note: to beg is to ask for something earnestly
an innings is a team or batter's turn to score runs in cricket

explanation.surface: Instructions on how to request a chance to get on the scoreboard.
explanation.walkthrough: An innings is a batting turn in cricket, when runs are scored.
explanation.definitionFit: Beginnings are origins or openings, the points at which things start.

clue.text: Piece of neckwear finally obscured blemish

indicators.note: the final letter of the neckwear word is hidden from view, so it is dropped

parts.note: a scarf is worn around the neck

explanation.surface: A scarf eventually hid a mark on someone's skin.
explanation.definitionFit: A scar is a mark left on skin after a wound heals, a kind of blemish.

clue.text: Golf — brutal boy ruined game

indicators.note: ruined means wrecked, so these words are broken up and reassembled

explanation.surface: A violent lad wrecked a round on the golf course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ruined' rearranges GOLF, BRUTAL and BOY into the thirteen letters.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a team sport played with an oval ball, the full name of the game often shortened.

clue.text: Part of body that's split on the outside, being hit from behind

indicators.note: the word for split sits around the body part, enclosing it

parts.note: to rend is to tear or split apart
the ear is a part of the body

explanation.surface: An injured body part, torn open, after a blow from the rear.
explanation.definitionFit: To rear-end a vehicle is to crash into it from behind.

clue.text: Blast of the horn given to Heather, driving casually?

parts.note: a toot is a short sound on a horn
ling is another name for common heather

explanation.surface: Someone sounds the horn at a woman named Heather while out on a relaxed drive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heather' looks like a woman's name; it is the plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Tootling means going along in a leisurely, unhurried way, often in a car.

clue.text: Rod said to be a wicked brother

indicators.note: said signals that the word for rod is spoken, giving a word that sounds the same

parts.note: a cane is a rod or stick used for walking or punishment

explanation.surface: A stick is supposedly the mark of a villainous sibling.
explanation.walkthrough: In the Bible, Cain killed his brother Abel.
explanation.definitionFit: Cain, son of Adam and Eve, murdered his brother Abel in Genesis.

clue.text: Concert being performed attended by politician making a point

parts.note: a prom is a promenade concert, as at the BBC Proms
on means taking place or being staged
a Tory is a British Conservative politician

explanation.surface: A politician attends a concert to make a political point.
explanation.walkthrough: The Proms are a famous London summer series of classical concerts; a Tory is a British Conservative.
explanation.definitionFit: A promontory is a headland jutting into the sea, also called a point.

clue.text: Such delight repeatedly comes to me in a Beatles song

definitions.text: Such delight repeatedly comes to me in a Beatles song

parts.words: Such delight repeatedly comes to me in a Beatles song
parts.note: the word meaning delight, said twice and followed by me, names an early hit by the Beatles

explanation.surface: Someone finds joy keeps arriving whenever they hear a favourite Beatles tune.
explanation.walkthrough: The Beatles' 1963 single was titled with this word twice followed by 'Me'.
explanation.definitionFit: To please is to delight, and the song title repeats it twice before 'Me'.

clue.text: Cap removed from toy gun

indicators.note: in a down clue the cap is the top letter, which is taken away

parts.note: to trifle with something is to toy with it

explanation.surface: A child's pretend weapon has had its cap taken off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cap' and 'toy gun' suggest a cap gun; cap here is the first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A rifle is a long-barrelled firearm, a type of gun.

clue.text: Exist with ridicule and anger about disease

parts.note: to be is to exist
to rib is to tease or mock

indicators.note: about indicates turning round, so the word for anger is read backwards

parts.note: ire is anger

explanation.surface: Living with mockery and fury in response to an illness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns IRE into ERI.
explanation.definitionFit: Beriberi is a disease caused by a lack of vitamin B1 (thiamine).

clue.text: Began with a situation that could make roof leaky, we hear

indicators.note: we hear signals that the phrase is spoken, giving words that sound alike

parts.words: a situation that could make roof leaky
parts.note: a roof whose lead sheeting has gone, lead off, would let rain in

explanation.surface: A worry that started with roofing trouble and a leak.
explanation.walkthrough: Lead, the metal, is used on roofs; its removal leaves a roof leaky.
explanation.definitionFit: To lead off is to begin or open proceedings, so the past tense means began.

clue.text: Hit covered by band — rubbish!

indicators.note: covered by means the answer lies concealed within the words that follow

explanation.surface: A dismissive verdict on a pop hit recorded by a group.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hit' looks like a chart success; it is a verb meaning beat.
explanation.definitionFit: To drub someone is to beat them soundly, to strike repeatedly.

clue.text: Son became older, returning as artist

indicators.note: returning means going back, so the combined letters are read in the opposite direction

parts.note: aged means grew older

explanation.surface: A son grew up and came home as a painter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' turns SAGED round to read DEGAS.
explanation.definitionFit: Edgar Degas was a French Impressionist painter famous for ballet dancers.

clue.text: The sign of a 'distressed' monk

parts.note: distressed is read as de-tressed, having locks of hair removed, as a monk's shaven crown

explanation.surface: Something that shows a holy brother is upset.
explanation.walkthrough: 'distressed' looks like upset; the quotes invite reading it as 'de-tressed', hair taken off.
explanation.definitionFit: A tonsure is the shaved patch on a monk's head, the mark of having lost his tresses.
